DNS::enable
Description
This iRules command sets the service state to enabled for the current
dns packet.
Note
: This command requires the DNS Profile, which is only enabled
as part of GTM or the DNS Services add-on.
Syntax
DNS
::
enable
DNS::enable <gtm|dnssec|dnsx|bind|cache|all>
Sets the service state to enabled for the current dns packet (reset
to default for future packets)
gtm - Global Traffic Manager
dnsx - DNS Express
DNSSEC - DNS security extensions
bind - BIG-IP bind
cache - DNS caching (added in 11.2)
Examples
Related Information
Valid Events:
DNS_REQUEST
,
DNS_RESPONSE
,
GLOBAL_GTM
